title: Review workflow: pinned toolchain and non-root container builds
summary: The review pipeline's build job no longer writes into the runner's checkout. It installs a pinned Rust 1.99.0 toolchain, mounts the base checkout read-only, and redirects CARGO_HOME and CARGO_TARGET_DIR into a runner-owned build-out folder that the container writes as the runner's own uid. The osf binary and the work-item command are then read back from that folder, and every job that mounts a writable out directory now chmods it for the image user. The rest of the diff is a mechanical test-assertion rewrite from assert!(x.is_empty()) to assert_eq!(x, Vec::new()), plus new workflow-shape tests that pin these container invariants.

nodes.label: Pull request event
nodes.subtitle: pull_request
nodes.summary: The GitHub event that starts review.yml. Its payload supplies the PR number, title and body that become the work item.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: workflow definition
nodes.summary: The review pipeline definition. This change adds the build-out folder, the read-only base mount, the pinned toolchain step and the chmod lines, and repoints the binary artifact at build-out.

nodes.label: ci.yml
nodes.subtitle: workflow definition
nodes.summary: The CI pipeline. Both jobs that previously added clippy and rustfmt to whatever toolchain the image shipped now install and default to Rust 1.99.0 explicitly.

nodes.label: Runner workspace
nodes.subtitle: ${{ github.workspace }}
nodes.summary: The host directory holding the base checkout and the new build-out folder. The runner creates build-out and owns everything the container writes there.

nodes.label: base checkout
nodes.subtitle: mounted :ro
nodes.summary: The base branch checkout. Every container mount of /base is now read-only, so no build step can mutate the runner's tree.

nodes.label: build-out
nodes.subtitle: CARGO_HOME + CARGO_TARGET_DIR
nodes.summary: A runner-owned folder created before the build. It holds cargo-home and target, so the container's compiler output lands where the runner can read and upload it.

nodes.label: out
nodes.subtitle: chmod -R a+rwX
nodes.summary: The per-job output directory mounted writable into the review containers. Each job that mounts it now chmods it so the image user can write.

nodes.label: cargo build container
nodes.subtitle: cargo build --release --bin osf
nodes.summary: Builds the osf binary from the base branch with no cache. It now runs as the runner uid, reads /base read-only and writes cargo-home and target into build-out.

nodes.label: work-item container
nodes.subtitle: osf review work-item
nodes.summary: Runs the freshly built osf against the pull request payload. It now runs as the runner uid and reads the binary from the read-only build-out mount.

nodes.label: review containers
nodes.subtitle: review, verify, publish
nodes.summary: The later jobs that mount out writable and run the review commands. They gain a chmod so the image user can write into the mounted directory.

nodes.label: osf binary
nodes.subtitle: build-out/target/release/osf
nodes.summary: The release binary built in the container. Its artifact path moved from base/target/release/osf to build-out/target/release/osf.

nodes.label: review_workflow tests
nodes.subtitle: container invariants
nodes.summary: New integration tests that assert the build job makes build-out, mounts base read-only, runs as the runner user, reads only the automatic token, and that every writable out mount is chmodded.

nodes.label: assertion rewrites
nodes.subtitle: is_empty to assert_eq
nodes.summary: Mechanical rewrites across the lint, config, work-item, reviewer and scan test suites, replacing assert!(x.is_empty()) with assert_eq!(x, Vec::new()) so failures print the actual contents.
